_comment: Predeclared case lists for the slice 4 generation checks (per-step latent parity, isolated VAE decoding, complete pipeline PNG). Explicit lists read by both the Python reference exporters and the native checker. Written before any slice 4 result existed. Prompt ids refer to cases.json (plain, long-near-limit, unicode-finnish, unicode-cjk). Sizes are the six supported sizes (width x height): square 1024x1024 and 768x768, portrait 864x1152 and 672x896, landscape 1152x864 and 896x672. Z-Image Turbo's supported step range is 4...12 (default 8): the denoise and pipeline cases cover the minimum (4), an intermediate value (6 and 8) and the maximum (12). Seeds are fixed so every run reproduces.
_comment_decision: Owner decision (resolves slice 3 R3): the DECISIVE comparison of the prediction is native compiled (mlx-swift compile of the whole forward) against MFLUX's production compiled path, ZImage._predict (mx.compile(predict), the closure generate_image uses). The eager comparisons (native eager vs MFLUX eager, MFLUX eager vs MFLUX compiled) are retained and recorded but never decide. Limits are unchanged from NATIVE_MLX_PLAN.md. The VAE has no compiled production path (mflux decodes eagerly), so its decisive comparison is native eager vs MFLUX eager, i.e. production against production.
